name: Evil Bat Eyes
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.offerRewardText:
Great!  You got the eyes!  I hope hunting those bats was frightening for you, because if it scared a brave Champion like yourself, then those eyes will certainly scare our Faire visitors.

Take these tickets, adventurer, and thank you for your service.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Do you ever find yourself wandering in a cave, late at night, looking for adventure? You do? Really? Well, then you've seen the creepy eyes of bats staring at you from high up, waiting for you to let down your guard so they can suck your blood!

Scary thought, don't you think? Of course! It's no doubt that bat eyes are scary!

Will you bring me some evil bat eyes, adventurer? I want them for... something I'm designing. Something scary.

You can get them from the bats of the Eastern Plaguelands.
